div.div: رِيحٌ سَاكِرَةٌ (tropical:) Wind becoming still. (A.) And لَيْلَةٌ سَاكِرَةٌ (tropical:) A still night; a night in which the wind is still; (S, * A;) a night in which there is no wind. (TA.) And مَآءٌ سَاكِرٌ (tropical:) Still, not running, water. (AZ, TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
